description: Canonical static data model for PERSIA clan intelligence.

entities.players: Stable internal player identities and current display metadata.
entities.snapshots: Timestamped observations of clan membership and player state.
entities.leagues: Weekly league seasons and PERSIA results.
entities.memberships: Historical membership intervals keyed by player_id.

identity.player_id: Stable internal identifier owned by this site; not a War Drone account ID.
identity.display_name: Current in-game display name; may change over time.
identity.rank: Snapshot-local position only; never an identity key.

immutability.canonical_data: May be extended/corrected by new confirmed observations without rewriting raw reports.
